m0-context.title: Load baseline context
m0-context.imperative: Read inherited crew doctrine and the register models (EXCURSION_BRIEF, CRITIC_HANDOFF, global-orchestrator critical-review section), the handoff, and each of the five files to edit. Verify the handoff is complete. Attest c1.

postconditions.statement: context + register models + handoff loaded; handoff complete

m1-brief.title: Author the shared design-it-twice brief
m1-brief.imperative: Write NEW skills/_shared/design-it-twice-brief.md — a dense, agent-facing fill-in brief in the CRITIC_HANDOFF/EXCURSION_BRIEF register: constraint menus (interfaces + plans), comparison axes (depth/locality/seam placement/testability), output rule (recommendation or named hybrid, never a menu), framing block with illustrative sketch marked 'not a proposal', untaken-road record, panel-vs-single record. Do not copy-paste EXCURSION_BRIEF.

postconditions.statement: brief exists and carries the required tokens

check.command: test -f skills/_shared/design-it-twice-brief.md && grep -Eqi 'not a proposal' skills/_shared/design-it-twice-brief.md && grep -Eqi 'untaken road' skills/_shared/design-it-twice-brief.md && grep -Eqi 'panel' skills/_shared/design-it-twice-brief.md && grep -Eqi 'depth' skills/_shared/design-it-twice-brief.md

payload.cmd: test -f skills/_shared/design-it-twice-brief.md && grep -Eqi 'not a proposal' skills/_shared/design-it-twice-brief.md && grep -Eqi 'untaken road' skills/_shared/design-it-twice-brief.md && grep -Eqi 'panel' skills/_shared/design-it-twice-brief.md && grep -Eqi 'depth' skills/_shared/design-it-twice-brief.md
